items.title: Google AI Research Releases Agile Deliberation Framework for Gray-Area Image Classifiers
items.summary: Google Research released Agile Deliberation, a human-in-the-loop framework that helps users define subjective visual concepts through borderline images. In 18 live sessions, it lifted Gemini-based classifier F1 by 10.5 points over zero-shot. The post Google AI Research Releases Agile Deliberation Framework for Gray-Area Image Classifiers appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: webAI Releases TwIL-8B, an 8.8B Reasoning Model Scoring 98.2 on MATH-500
items.summary: webAI released TwIL-8B, an 8.8B reasoning model post-trained from IBM Granite 4.2 8B. It posts 98.2 on MATH-500 and 81.6 on LiveCodeBench, but trails similar-size models on knowledge benchmarks. The post webAI Releases TwIL-8B, an 8.8B Reasoning Model Scoring 98.2 on MATH-500 appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Ricursive AI Releases Ripple-65B Preview: A 65B Dense Open-Weight Model Scoring 80.5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1
items.summary: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B dense open-weight LLM under Apache 2.0. It scores 80.5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1, ahead of US open models up to 15x its size. The post Ricursive AI Releases Ripple-65B Preview: A 65B Dense Open-Weight Model Scoring 80.5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Tencent WeVisOne-VL Unifies Detection, OCR, Segmentation and Matting
items.summary: Tencent’s WeChat Vision team released WeVisOne-VL, an Apache 2.0 vision language model in 2B and 4B sizes. It handles detection, OCR, counting, segmentation and alpha matting in one model, with a 9.6M-parameter pixel decoder. The post Tencent WeVisOne-VL Unifies Detection, OCR, Segmentation and Matting appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Anthropic Releases FlashProve: Cryptographic Proofs That a Reply Came From Committed Weights
items.summary: Anthropic released FlashProve, an Apache 2.0 zkSNARK prototype that proves a reply came from a committed model without revealing weights. It proves Llama 4 Maverick at 110 tokens/second on 1 H100, with 19 MB proofs. The post Anthropic Releases FlashProve: Cryptographic Proofs That a Reply Came From Committed Weights appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: NVIDIA Shows 3 Ways to Speed Up MoE Inference on DGX Spark, Lifting Ling-3.0-flash Throughput 42.5%
items.summary: NVIDIA shows how 3 stacked optimizations speed up MoE inference on a single DGX Spark. On Ant Group inclusionAI's 124B Ling-3.0-flash, GSM8K decode throughput rose 42.5% with no detectable accuracy change. The post NVIDIA Shows 3 Ways to Speed Up MoE Inference on DGX Spark, Lifting Ling-3.0-flash Throughput 42.5% appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Soniox STT v6 Adds Agent Text Input and Echo Filtering for Voice Agents
items.summary: Soniox has released Soniox STT v6, the latest generation of its speech-to-text API. Soniox STT v6 is a speech-to-text model that reads what a voice agent says while hearing the caller. It uses that text to recognize short replies and to drop the agent’s own voice. The release ships as stt-rt-v6 for streaming and stt-async-v6 […] The post Soniox STT v6 Adds Agent Text Input and Echo Filtering for Voice Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80%
items.summary: OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend for its monorepo. It handles branches independently, reuses stored packfiles across fetches, cut median push latency by nearly 80%, and now delivers nearly a petabyte of Git data per day. The post OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80% appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Zyphra AI Introduces Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA): A Path to True Subquadratic Attention
items.summary: Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA) is a tree-indexed sparse attention method that retrofits frozen LLMs with 4B tokens of distillation, matching dense attention on reasoning and 256K retrieval benchmarks. The post Zyphra AI Introduces Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA): A Path to True Subquadratic Attention appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: The Letter Company Releases Letterpress-1: A Coding Agent Built for Growth Engineering
items.summary: Letter has released the beta of Letterpress-1, a coding agent, harness and IDE for growth engineering. It reads a git-based site and its market, then opens pull requests for SEO, GEO and conversion work. The post The Letter Company Releases Letterpress-1: A Coding Agent Built for Growth Engineering appeared first on MarkTechPost.
